title: Recording: I Lie Around by Wings | 1971
content:
Studio A-1, A&R Recording, New York City
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Dixon Van Winkle

Paul and Linda McCartney worked on the song ‘I Lie Around’, which would eventually be released by Wings, on 2 February 1971.

They are likely to have recorded the lead and backing vocals during this day’s session, which occurred while the Ram album was being worked on.

‘I Lie Around’ was completed in November 1972 after the formation of Wings. It was released in June 1973 as the b-side of the ‘Live And Let Die’ single.

Page last updated: 11 November 2025
